topic: Luffy's rubber is the exact counter to Enel's Goro Goro no Mi
title: Only One Fruit Beats Enel (One Piece)
description: Enel is lightning itself, and Mantra hears every attack. Only one fruit in the world stops him. A short cut from our full What If: what if Luffy never ate the Gum-Gum Fruit? Full breakdown on the channel.
comment: Was Luffy's rubber luck, or Oda's plan from the start? Pick one.

lines.text: Only one fruit in the world beats Enel.

lines.text: Enel ate the Goro Goro no Mi. He isn't using lightning. He is lightning.

shot.fallback: anime style enel lightning skypiea, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And his Mantra means he hears every attack before it lands.

shot.fallback: anime style enel mantra observation haki, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Nobody on the Going Merry can touch him. Zoro's swords, Sanji's kicks, all of it.

shot.fallback: anime style going merry straw hats enel, dramatic lighting, no text
anime style luffy rubber enel, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: In canon, Enel throws 100 million volts, then 200 million. Nothing happens.

shot.fallback: anime style enel 200 million volt luffy, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: And he's horrified, because for the first time in his life, nobody fears him.

shot.fallback: anime style enel horrified luffy immune, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: People say Luffy won on pure grit. But grit doesn't survive 200 million volts.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy enel skypiea fight, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Take the fruit away, and the fight is over before it starts.

shot.fallback: anime style enel lightning luffy, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Oda didn't give Luffy a random fruit. He gave him Enel's exact counter.

lines.text: Remove it, and Enel wins, because
